body:
- fix(langgraph): fork before replaying an update checkpoint the thread moved past ( #9170 )

- fix(langgraph): keep an update_state on an older checkpoint out of its other branches ( #9165 )

- fix(langgraph): keep DeltaChannel counters on every update_state path ( #9142 )

- release(langgraph): 1.2.13 ( #9205 )

- fix(langgraph): don't walk history for a DeltaChannel that was never written ( #9141 )

- fix(langgraph): don't replay an abandoned branch into a DeltaChannel fork ( #8548 )

- chore(deps): bump notebook from 7.5.6 to 7.5.7 in /libs/langgraph ( #9168 )

- fix(langgraph): hydrate subgraph delta channels with the caller-resolved saver ( #8538 )

- fix(langgraph): stop reporting answered interrupts in get_state ( #9103 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 5 updates ( #9155 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-conformance with 2 updates ( #9145 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/sdk-py with 5 updates ( #9149 )

- chore(deps): bump tornado from 6.5.8 to 6.5.9 in /libs/langgraph ( #9160 )

- chore(deps-dev): bump types-requests from 2.33.0.20260712 to 2.33.0.20260906 in /libs/langgraph ( #9156 )

- chore(deps): bump pyjwt from 2.15.0 to 2.15.1 in /libs/langgraph ( #9140 )

- chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/langgraph ( #9138 )

- chore(deps): bump pyjwt from 2.14.0 to 2.15.0 in /libs/langgraph ( #9139 )

- chore(deps): bump pyjwt from 2.13.0 to 2.14.0 in /libs/langgraph ( #9126 )
summaryZh: LangGraph 发布了 1.2.13 版本，专注于多智能体工作流状态与图执行的稳定性修复。主要更新包括：在重放线程已越过的更新检查点之前进行分叉、将旧检查点上的 update_state 隔离在其分支之外、在每个 update_state 路径上保持 DeltaChannel 计数器，并修正了未写入 DeltaChannel 的历史遍历逻辑及子图增量通道的水合问题。

glossary.explanationZh: 检查点，LangGraph 中用于保存图在特定执行步骤的状态快照，以支持时间旅行和暂停恢复。
LangGraph 中用于管理状态增量更新和并发路径合并的核心通道结构。
子图，可嵌套在主工作流图中的独立图模块，用于构建可复用的复杂智能体逻辑。
工作流中断机制，允许智能体在特定节点暂停以等待人工输入或外部触发。
分叉操作，从图的某一个历史状态节点派生出一条新的执行分支。
